title: Contracted Services
caption: Service structure is distinct from the staff reporting chart.

title: Capture options
caption: Devices, input methods, client software and capture channels are separate concepts.

title: Connectivity and paper
caption: Offline entry is a proposed route. Paper remains an explicit existing route.

title: People and application surfaces
caption: Each surface has a distinct purpose. A knowledge hub remains a proposed surface.

title: Platform connections
caption: Adapter implementation and live account verification are different readiness states.

title: Business destinations
caption: Separate adapters preserve choices without treating every provider as a committed feature.

title: Software stack
caption: Languages, frameworks, access controls, services and databases have separate nodes.

title: Assessment responsibilities
caption: Staff enter data, the application derives results, and a reviewer controls release.

title: Revision and change control
caption: Changing a submitted assessment creates another record, rather than rewriting its history.

title: Callable information tools
caption: Each tool has a specific input, transformation and limit; these are independent operations.

title: Information sources and derived records
caption: Structured records, deterministic derivations and future documents are distinct sources.

title: Relational data model
caption: Each entity is an actual pilot table. Answers and signatures are fields, not separate tables.
